# Space Station Silicon Valley (US 1.0), recorded by N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs from
# web/shader_plan.json in headless Chrome. Section 0 is the launcher, the game's boot, its opening and the title.
# Section level1 is Smashing Start reached as a player does: Start until Bank Select, A on a new bank, Start through the
# new game's intro, A on the Mission Brief, then a walk with the default keys (the stick W A S D, A Space). Then a
# section a level, 2 to 32 (gGameState.level, 0x803F2D38; the decompilation's include/levels.h names them), each reached
# in a load of its own from the title by Module._sssv_web_warp(<level>) (src/game/recomp_api.cpp: the game's own level
# loader, as the desktop's test control has it), waited on until the level runs, then walked about for 15 s. 33 and 34
# are no levels, and 35 is the credits, not recorded.
# Then the misses of web/play_plan_extended.json's play on a new profile in Chrome, Smashing Start and then Swamp of
# Eternal Stench and Something Fishy reached in the same load by the warp, added to those levels' sections.
